purpose: Assembles an EU AI Act Annex IV technical documentation pack, validates the conformity-assessment route (internal control vs notified body), checks CE-marking and EU Declaration of Conformity readiness, and scores completeness per Arts 9/10/15/17. Prepare-ahead: 2 Dec 2027 (verify Digital Omnibus). Decision-support draft, not a conformity certificate.
